title: Totems, auras and a smarter menu
items: TotemPop: smaller totem animation on screen and new totem particles (feathers with a glowing halo, or golden sparks).
Aura cosmetic: angel light, devil embers, sky sparkles, stars, hearts, feathers or music notes around you.
Hit Particles: new pixel feathers, like the wings.
Chat heads, a movable scoreboard without red numbers, Nether coords and a weapon break alert.
Favorite mods with the star, and the search now finds options inside every mod.
The client now tells you when there is an update and installs it with one click.

title: Sounds and options
items: HitSounds: pixel pop, bell, laser, coin, punch, angel harp, devil and click, each with a crit version.
Every option with several modes now shows all of them at once.

title: Pets and skies
items: Angel Devil and Cloud pets follow you, wave, celebrate your kills, nap when you are AFK and hide when you are low.
Halo styles: ring, broken, crown and devil horns.
Main menu sky: sunset, starry night, day or real time, with parallax.
Music Player for your own MP3 files and an animated gradient name.
